notes.title: Teller’s Duty Demo Update V.1.0.9 & News
notes.notes:
Hi Tellers! 

We’ve just rolled out a fresh update for the demo. Thank you so much for playing, sharing feedback, and reporting bugs. It really helps us polish the game!



Here’s what’s new in this version:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/6a86b51df60e6a759aaa82d06af3e66293209f0e.png"]
\[Visual] You can now customize your cat’s name

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/d8a1f6c5ca5f70825e4ee7f8699e3d0714c407cc.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/81aaec20e755a608e1c31eb4d315b69d610b18ab.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/fe5de6d509360f1f5529c170a42885a8e8d294ff.png"]

\[UI] Smoother animations when switching menus

\[UI] Redesigned some main menu interface

\[Visual] Added window-opening animation before starting a transaction



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/d64ffe65eb51bea6e33dd34af2c8f3735d2e0d04.png"]

\[Achievement] Steam achievement "Expelled"

\[Gameplay] ID card stamp wrong validation 

Other minor bug fixes to improve your teller experience



We’re also excited to share that Teller’s Duty is joining the Cat Awareness Feline Sale on Steam 2025, Sep 9 - Sep 19 2025, hosted by Devcatgames! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/3919139cea5c2950c112bf2a758ffc4209c9f4ba.png"]

We’re also happy to announce that Teller’s Duty has been selected as one of the Top 40 SEA Game Awards Finalists 2025 at Level UP KL, hosted by MDEC! (source)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/39744707156b9e4b36a318a91b23154fca89c847.png"]



That’s all for now! Keep an eye out for the next update



See you at the counter,

Hiscory Team

notes.title: Teller's Duty Demo Update V.1.0.7
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes & Improvements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/6a86b51df60e6a759aaa82d06af3e66293209f0e.png"] 

\[Audio SFX] Improved and added new sound effects for gameplay.

\[Achievement] Added achievement system for the demo version.

\[Money Drawer] Implemented auto money addition/removal when holding the add/remove button.

\[Mailbox] Introduced a mailbox system.



 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/fe5de6d509360f1f5529c170a42885a8e8d294ff.png"]  

\[Optimization] Optimized several in-game assets for better performance.

\[Dialogue] Balanced some dialogue lines to better fit the context.

\[Work Hours] Adjusted work hours for each day.

\[Appointment] Tellers can now schedule appointments with customers.

\[Stamp] Forged documents for added challenge


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/d64ffe65eb51bea6e33dd34af2c8f3735d2e0d04.png"]  

\[Health System] Health system now functions correctly.

\[Expense System] Expense system now works as intended.

\[Customer Transactions] Fixed issue where the same customer appeared multiple times in a day with repeated dialogue.

\[Minor Bugs] Fixed various minor bugs and issues.

\[Minor Bugs] Fixed deposit bug on day 2

\[Minor Bugs] Fixed withdraw limit on day 6

notes.title: Teller's Duty Demo Update V.1.0.4
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes & Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/6a86b51df60e6a759aaa82d06af3e66293209f0e.png
 [New Feature] Manual Count.
 [New Feature] Audio Tape, You can now freely switch songs while working.
 [New Feature] Dynamic Transaction, Customer errors are now dynamic and unpredictable, even the developers can’t anticipate what mistakes might come next.
 [New Feature] Dynamic light/sun – experience morning and afternoon ambiance as the lighting adapts naturally.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/82fc15bfe6c600abe6ab69edf8121cbc2ed9a513.gif
 [New UI] Enhanced document UI—more readable.
 [New Pointer] A pointer grab is now available when interacting with grab-able objects..
 [New Characters] More characters and additional transactions added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/fe5de6d509360f1f5529c170a42885a8e8d294ff.png

 [UI] Improved some UI.
 [Customer] Adjusted some customer dialogues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/d64ffe65eb51bea6e33dd34af2c8f3735d2e0d04.png

 [Minor] Fixed some minor bugs.

notes.title: Teller's Duty Demo Update V.1.0.3
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes & Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/6a86b51df60e6a759aaa82d06af3e66293209f0e.png
 [New Feature] Multi-preview document feature added.
 [New Mini Game] A new mini-game has been added.
 [New Feature] Health system added for both the teller and the cat.
 [New UI] Enhanced document UI—more readable and mobile-friendly.
 [New Characters] More characters and additional transactions added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/fe5de6d509360f1f5529c170a42885a8e8d294ff.png

 [Refactor] Refactored all system code for improved stability.
 [UI] Improved notification UI tutorial for the money drawer.
 [UI] Adjusted the position of interactable objects on the teller desk during the end-of-day summary.
 [UI] Adjusted some UI

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/d64ffe65eb51bea6e33dd34af2c8f3735d2e0d04.png

 [Calendar] Fixed incorrect date issue when returning to the main menu and resuming gameplay.
 [Transaction] Fixed invalid transaction validator issue (teller received a warning when it should have been valid).
 [Minor] Fixed some minor bugs.

notes.title: Teller's Duty Demo Update V.1.0.2

 Fixed several minor bugs.
